name: Bamboo
description: Bamboo canes rising in segments, each joint a small gap, with sprays of slender leaves springing from some of the nodes.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: @calc(16 + 9 * ((@x * 7 + 3) % 5))%; width: @calc(18 + 5 * ((@x * 3) % 3))%; top: 5%; bottom: 0; border-radius: 14% / 4%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: @calc(24 + 9 * ((@x * 7 + 3) % 5))%; top: -20%; width: 115%; height: 46%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--spray); clip-path: @var(--spray); transform-origin: 4% 50%; -webkit-transform: rotate(@p(-30deg, 25deg, 155deg, 210deg)); transform: rotate(@p(-30deg, 25deg, 155deg, 210deg)); opacity: @p(0, 0, 1); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
